analogy.rationale: Bacterial 30S ribosomal subunit inhibitors block bacterial translation, but human cytosolic ribosomes are structurally distinct, so these drugs should produce little transcriptional response in human cells; the closest analog is another bacterial ribosome inhibitor (50S), with general protein synthesis inhibitors and other antibacterial classes as weaker matches.
